systems.system: Mobile telephony penetration rate (ARCEP Observatoire du marche des telecommunications 2020)
systems.country_label: taux de penetration de la telephonie mobile 53.5% in 2020; sector customers 8.7 million in 2020 (+13.3% on 2019); derived from subscriber counts, not a survey of people owning a phone

note: The 53.5% (2020) is a penetration rate tied to subscriber/customer counts (8.7 million), not a household survey of people who own a phone, so no ownership fact; recorded as a systems entry of class other.
